######## warranty_claim/fresh
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 March 2026 I received the Pixel 9 Pro (Google, model GA05) from you. On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers.

Steps I have already taken: Factory reset

As the seller, you are responsible under consumer law for goods that do not conform to the contract, and I believe this fault falls under that responsibility.

I request that you repair or replace the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge. If you cannot do this within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, I will ask to end the contract and receive a full refund.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting the Verbraucherzentrale.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

######## warranty_claim/answered
Jane Doe
2 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 March 2026 I received the Pixel 9 Pro (Google, model GA05) from you. On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers.

Steps I have already taken: Factory reset

As the seller, you are responsible under consumer law for goods that do not conform to the contract, and I believe this fault falls under that responsibility.

Because you have refused to bring the goods into conformity, I ask to end the contract and receive a full refund. I will return the Pixel 9 Pro once you confirm how you would like it returned.

Please confirm in writing by 16 October 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting the Verbraucherzentrale.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

######## warranty_claim/reviewed-DE
Jane Doe
2 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 March 2026 I received the Pixel 9 Pro (Google, model GA05) from you. On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers.

Steps I have already taken: Factory reset

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery. Because the fault became apparent within one year of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.

Because you have refused to bring the goods into conformity, I am entitled to end the contract. I request a full refund. I will return the Pixel 9 Pro at your expense once you confirm.

Please confirm in writing by 16 October 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting the Verbraucherzentrale.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On [date of first letter] I wrote to you about a fault in the Pixel 9 Pro, delivered on 1 March 2026. Since then, I have not received a reply.

As the seller, you are responsible under consumer law for goods that do not conform to the contract, and I believe this fault falls under that responsibility.

I request that you repair or replace the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge. If you cannot do this within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, I will ask to end the contract and receive a full refund.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to the Verbraucherzentrale and consider taking the matter to court.

######## follow_up/reviewed-DE
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Final notice: lack of conformity, Pixel 9 Pro

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 2 October 2026 I wrote to you about a fault in the Pixel 9 Pro, delivered on 1 March 2026. Since then, you have refused to resolve the problem.

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery. Because the fault became apparent within one year of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

Because you have refused to bring the goods into conformity, I am entitled to end the contract. I request a full refund. I will return the Pixel 9 Pro at your expense once you confirm.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to the Verbraucherzentrale and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

Attached:
- Copy of my letter of 2 October 2026
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

######## rejection_response/fresh
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Your rejection of my claim: Pixel 9 Pro

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

I asked you to resolve a fault in the Pixel 9 Pro (Google, model GA05), delivered on 1 March 2026. You rejected my claim.

I do not accept this decision. The fault is as follows: The screen flickers.

Steps I have already taken: Factory reset

As the seller, you are responsible under consumer law for goods that do not conform to the contract, and I believe this fault falls under that responsibility.

Because you have refused to bring the goods into conformity, I ask to end the contract and receive a full refund. I will return the Pixel 9 Pro once you confirm how you would like it returned.

Please reconsider your decision and confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If you maintain your rejection, I will take further steps, including contacting the Verbraucherzentrale.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

######## formal_complaint/fresh
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: The Verbraucherzentrale
Subject: Complaint about Acme Electronics GmbH: Pixel 9 Pro

Dear Sir or Madam,

I would like to make a formal complaint about Acme Electronics GmbH. On 1 March 2026 I received the Pixel 9 Pro (Google, model GA05) from them. On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers.

Steps I have already taken: Factory reset

I believe the seller is responsible for this fault under consumer law, which makes sellers responsible for goods that do not conform to the contract.

I am asking for a full refund. Please look into this complaint and let me know how you can help, including any next steps available to me.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

Dear Sir or Madam,

I would like to make a formal complaint about Acme Electronics GmbH. On 1 March 2026 I received the Pixel 9 Pro (Google, model GA05) from them. On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers.

Steps I have already taken: Factory reset

On 2 October 2026 I asked the seller in writing to resolve the problem. The seller refused, giving this reason: "Not a defect".

I believe the seller is responsible for this fault under consumer law, which makes sellers responsible for goods that do not conform to the contract.

I am asking for a full refund. Please look into this complaint and let me know how you can help, including any next steps available to me.
